Fourier product-to-sum gives the FULL real space P_{dL}; independently reconstructed Laurent complexifications and verified exact ranks 2dL+1 for every 1<=d<=5,1<=L<=3, without using the source checker. In finite-dimensional tangent coordinates submersion yields a neighborhood of zero and the scalar multiplier built into H_g yields all of P_{dL}; this does not establish saturation or an unrescaled physical claim.
